topic: How we work: building a backend and API step by step
caption:
Your users never see the backend. They feel it every time the app is fast, safe and just works. ⚙️

Here's how we approach building one:

1️⃣ Model the data and business rules
2️⃣ Design the API (REST or GraphQL) before building it
3️⃣ Build it with tests, in Node.js, Python/FastAPI or .NET
4️⃣ Secure and deploy with Docker, CI/CD and AWS
5️⃣ Monitor and improve once real users arrive

All through our ISO-certified process. Swipe for each step. →

Need a backend for your web or mobile app? DM us API and tell us what it has to do.

Share this with someone building a product. 🔁

slides.title: How we build a backend.
slides.sub: The part users never see, and always feel.

slides.title: Model the data and rules.
slides.body: Before any code: what you store, how it connects and the business rules it must follow. Then we pick the right database.

slides.title: Design the API first.
slides.body: We agree the REST or GraphQL contract up front, so web and mobile teams can build against it in parallel.

slides.title: Build it with tests.
slides.body: Node.js and TypeScript, Python/FastAPI or .NET, chosen to fit. Automated tests catch problems before your users do.

slides.title: Secure and deploy.
slides.body: Authentication, secrets kept out of the code, Docker and CI/CD pipelines, and deployment on AWS.

slides.title: Monitor and improve.
slides.body: Launch is the start. We watch errors and performance and improve as real usage grows.

slides.title: Let's design your backend.
slides.sub: Tell us what your app needs to do. We'll suggest how we'd build it.
